pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarassa pūgassa saṃghassa sacīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyattaṃ hoti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.4: atha kho chabbaggiyā bhikkhū yena so pūgo ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.6: dethāvuso imāni cīvarāni imesaṃ bhikkhūnan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.9: bahū āvuso saṃghassa dāyakā, bahū saṃghassa bhattā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.10: ime tumhe nissāya tumhe saṃpassantā idha viharanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.11: tumhe ce imesaṃ na dassatha, atha ko carahi imesaṃ dassati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.12: dethāvuso imāni cīvarāni imesaṃ bhikkhūnan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.13: atha kho so pūgo chabbaggiyehi bhikkhūhi nippīḷiyamāno yathāpaṭiyattaṃ cīvaraṃ chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ datvā saṃghaṃ bhattena parivisi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.14: ye te bhikkhū jānanti saṃghassa sacīvarabhattaṃ paṭiyattaṃ na ca jānanti chabbaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dinnan ti, te evam āhaṃsu:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.17: yathāpaṭiyattaṃ cīvaraṃ ayyā chabbaggiyā ayyānaṃ chabbaggiyānaṃ pariṇāmesun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.19: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ saṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ puggalassa pariṇāmessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.20: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave jānaṃ saṃghikaṃ . . . pariṇāmethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.23: kathañ hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā jānaṃ saṃghikaṃ . . . pariṇāmessatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.24: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.25: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:1.26.1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ saṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pariṇataṃ puggalassa pariṇāmeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.1.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti so vā āroceti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.1.10: cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārā antamaso cuṇṇapiṇḍo pi dantakaṭṭhaṃ pi dasikasuttaṃ pi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.1.12: dassāma karissāmā 'ti vācā bhinnā hoti, taṃ puggalassa pariṇāmeti, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.2.1: pariṇate pariṇatasaññī puggalassa pariṇāmeti, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.2.2: pariṇate vematiko puggalassa pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.2.4: saṃghassa pariṇataṃ aññassa saṃghassa vā cetiyassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.2.5: cetiyassa pariṇataṃ aññassa cetiyassa vā saṃghassa vā puggalassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.2.6: puggalassa pariṇataṃ aññassa puggalassa vā saṃghassa vā cetiyassa vā pariṇāmeti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc82:2.3.3: yattha tumhākaṃ deyyadhammo paribhogaṃ vā labheyya paṭisaṃkhāraṃ vā labheyya ciraṭṭhitiko vā assa yattha vā pana tumhākaṃ cittaṃ pasīdati tattha dethā 'ti bhaṇati,
